name: UK Global Visa Founders
structure: CHECK(connected: end | new: INVITE(note x1)(accepted: MSG x2 | not: end))

variants.body: Hi {FIRST_NAME} - your founder experience and Global Talent status caught our eye. Our Managing Partner would love to chat about a co-founder role at our new (validated and funded) AI B2B startup. We believe it’ll surpass our previous ventures, Reachdesk ($225M val) & Yieldify (acq. by Publicis).

steps.fallback: Hi - your founder experience and Global Talent status caught our eye. Our Managing Partner would love to chat about a co-founder role at our new (validated and funded) AI B2B startup. We believe it’ll surpass our previous ventures, Reachdesk ($225M val) & Yieldify (acq. by Publicis).

steps.what: opener, credibility, opinion question, asks for a call

variants.body:
Hi {FIRST_NAME} - great to connect. 

For context, we’re co-building {IDEA_PLAIN}. We’ve built 10 companies so far that have been backed by Global Tier 1 investors like Google Ventures, Softbank, a16z, and Sequoia.  

We’re looking for an exceptional operator with prior founder experience who’s looking to build again. Your profile stood out in our search, so I wanted to connect you to our Managing Partner, Jay for an intro call. 

Let me know if you’re interested, and I’ll set it up. 

Best,
Akhil
